To anyone reading this — whoever you are, whatever silent battles you're fighting — I just want you to know: it's okay to break down. It's okay to feel lost, to feel tired, to wonder if it ever gets better. Sometimes life feels unbearably heavy, and the nights seem endless. But I promise you, no matter how slow the healing feels, you are moving forward. Even on the days when it feels like you're standing still — you are growing in ways you can't yet see.   
 
You won’t always feel this broken. Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow... but someday you’ll wake up and realize the weight you’re carrying feels a little lighter. You'll breathe a little easier. Smiles will feel real again. It takes time — and an almost impossible kind of patience — but you will find the peace and happiness you deserve.   
 
This life — your life — is a one-time gift. You only get this one story. So even if today you feel like you’re drowning, please keep swimming. Please stay. The world needs your story. I’m proud of you for surviving the things you don’t even talk about. I believe in you. I love you. And even if you can’t believe it right now — better days are waiting for you.
